query: SELECT action.approved AS "approved: bool", action.result_content_id FROM action JOIN sequence ON sequence.id = action.sequence_id JOIN tool_execution AS approving_tool_execution ON approving_tool_execution.id = action.approving_tool_execution_id JOIN inference AS approving_inference ON approving_inference.id = approving_tool_execution.inference_id WHERE sequence.world_id = ? AND action.pending_action_id = ? AND approving_inference.agent_id = ?
